column2: The control is not reachable from the place a pass actually works.  `license_family.sh` says "source this, do not rewrite it", `gate-affero-rung` enforces it, and BOTH are aimed at INSTRUMENTS under compose/code/.  🔴 A pass reading payloads ad hoc in a shell — which is how every leg on this base reads a grant — passes through neither.  pass 77 wrote a fresh classifier in two instruments; this pass wrote one in a one-line pipeline.  Same defect, one layer further out, and the gate cannot see that layer.

🟢 No pass may publish a licence family from its own grep.  Every family cell goes through `family_of()` from compose/code/lib/license_family.sh, or through p312's `identify()`, and where the two disagree the disagreement is the finding — not something to resolve by picking one.

column2: 12britz/awesome-free-models serves a 137-BYTE LICENSE: three lines whose first is "CC0 1.0 Universal" and whose body reads "To the extent possible under law, the author has waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights to this work."  That is a PARAPHRASE.  It carries none of CC0's operative sections and NOT its fallback-licence clause.
🔴 CC0-1.0 — a clean permissive cell.  It classifies on the TITLE BLOCK, by design (P171), and the title block of a paraphrase is the real licence's name.

🟢 UNKNOWN-TEMPLATE — it abstains, because the payload matches no registered template.  Its LABEL field still reads "CC0 1.0 Universal", taken from the first line, so a pass publishing the LABEL rather than the FAMILY would shelve the paraphrase as CC0 anyway.

🔵 The two instruments are each correct about their own question and a shelf cell needs BOTH.  `family_of()` answers "what licence is this text NAMED after"; `identify()` answers "is this the licence's ACTUAL TEXT".  🔴 A permissive cell published on the first alone can be a paraphrase, a truncation or a summary — and P171's title-block rule, which exists to stop a BODY grep lying, is exactly what makes the title-block classifier trust a paraphrase's heading.
🟢 A permissive family cell is publishable only when BOTH agree, or when the disagreement is published beside it.  This pass publishes 12britz as CC0-PARAPHRASE on that rule, not as CC0-1.0.

A gate arm asserting that no shelf publishes a bare permissive family for a payload `identify()` grades UNKNOWN-TEMPLATE, unless the cell names the disagreement.  NOT built this pass.  Stated so it is not mistaken for done.
